race.comment: PARTHENOPE (6) has her issues, but what she's shown when on the racecourse has been superb. She's shown good speed and ability in both and her recent trial here recently was super. Can work across from out wide and make every post a winner. MUST BE SAIN (2) won two back before a 0.7L defeat here last time out over 1206m. Back to the scene of the win two back though and Loy hops back on board. Racing well and can feature in the finish again. FAMOSO (1) comes back in grade today which looks a good move for his chances. He jumped the favourite here two back and comes back to 1080m now. Had support in a Federal here first-up and he can play a leading role. CALAIS BLISS (10) was solid on resumption on the heavy deck at Albury and may be better suited on top of the ground. She's a winner second-up previously and makes plenty of appeal. MYSTIC AIR (12) can feature first-up.
